text.en:
Chairmanship. The Presidential Assistant for Food Security and
Agricultural Modernization shall henceforth be the Chairman, in an ex officio capacity, of the
Governing Bodies of the following:
a) National Food Authority;
b) National Irrigation Administration;
c) Philippine Coconut Authority; and
d) Fertilizer and Pesticide Authority.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, which
are inconsistent with this Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
